summary: Verified buyer e-ticket (OrderStatusPage /order/{id}) 'Simpan Tiket (Gambar)' and 'Tambah ke Kalender HP' buttons work on desktop. Both downloads succeed with no console errors. Tested with verified order #9835 (id e98924ec-a033-40ea-99fa-ad5a0daca887).
critical_code_review_comments: OrderStatusPage.js is ~450+ lines with inline canvas drawing logic mirrored from ManualOrder page — consider extracting drawTicketCanvas() into a shared util (/utils/eticket.js) to avoid drift between buyer & manual e-tickets.

Logo preload useEffect ties Image().crossOrigin='anonymous' to CDN CORS response; if the CDN header ever changes, canvas will taint silently — add a try/catch around toDataURL with a user-facing toast.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Buyer e-ticket download verified: tiket-9835.png ~141KB, acara-nonton-9835.ics 340B with valid BEGIN:VCALENDAR. No console errors, no SecurityError/tainted canvas. Logo CDN sends access-control-allow-origin:* so crossOrigin='anonymous' preload works. Mobile Web Share / Google Calendar paths NOT tested (desktop-only path verified as requested).
